claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development and 110,983 ada for the Intersect budget administration fee.
Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way so nodes and applications can verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
Mithril addresses slow full-node synchronization and centralized-trust reliance by light clients.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
At submission, the requested amount does not on its own or in aggregate breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect overhead and third-party oversight.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, named addresses, role thresholds, and an external Oversight Committee.

The Oversight Committee consists of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, and its role is to verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic without discretion over governance decisions.
A public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for community auditing of TRSC and PSSC activity and on-chain metrics related to the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development via Intersect-administered smart contracts, presenting strategic infrastructure benefits, Intersect budget-process support, NCL compliance, and oversight mechanisms, while leaving detailed milestones, timeline, vendor contract terms, and technical deliverable acceptance criteria unstated.
